sentences.text: S1 stated that what the client tells him is confidential and will not be shared with the social worker or anyone else unless the client agrees, except in very rare cases where a 's
S1 stated that the letter before proceedings concerns a bruise on Alfie's arm seen by the nursery on the ninth of November and police being called to the house in October.
S1 stated that the letter records the client told Ms Okoye that Alfie fell off the sofa.
S2 stated that it was Jordan who slapped Alfie, not that he fell off the sofa.
S2 stated that Jordan slapped Alfie across the face because he would not eat his tea.
S2 stated the incident on the 8th of November occurred on Sunday at about five o'clock.
S2 stated that Jordan grabbed Alfie by the arm, really hard, and pulled him off the chair, which caused the bruise.
S2 stated she was at the sink when she saw the bruise on Alfie's arm.
S2 stated Jordan told her to say Alfie fell off the sofa when Ms Okoye came.
S2 stated that in October, they were arguing and shouting, and a neighbour rang the police, who only talked to them.
S2 stated Jordan is at his mum's this week and will be back on Saturday.
S1 stated the client has Universal Credit and child benefit for both children, but Jordan has the bank card for the joint account.
S2 stated her mum has been helping her with food this week.
S2 stated she wants her kids to stay with her.
S2 stated Jordan says he will take the kids and Poppy if she leaves him, claiming Poppy is his.
S2 stated Jordan has never taken the children anywhere without her agreement, but only says he will when they argue.
S1 advised that Jordan cannot just take the children and that he would have to go to court to take Poppy, which would involve a court hearing about what happened to Alfie.
S1 advised that the client can apply for a non-molestation order to stop Jordan coming to the house.
S1 advised that the client should tell Ms Okoye what really happened before the meeting on the first of December.
S1 stated that in his experience, a mum who tells the truth and acts to keep her child safe is in a much stronger position than one who backs her partner's story.
S1 asked for permission to write to Ms Okoye with the account provided by the client.
S2 gave permission for S1 to write to Ms Okoye with the account provided.
S1 advised that the client can ask for their Universal Credit to be paid into their own account.
S1 stated he would write to Ms Okoye by Thursday the twenty-sixth with the client's account and send her a copy.
S1 instructed the client to ring Harbridge Women's Aid today to talk about a safety plan for when Jordan is due back on Saturday.
S1 stated he would prepare a non-molestation application and they would meet again on Monday the thirtieth to go through it.
S2 agreed that Monday is fine for the meeting, noting her mum can have the kids.
S1 advised that if Jordan turns up and the client feels unsafe, she should ring 999.
S2 stated she would ring 999 if Jordan turns up and she feels unsafe.
